purpose: Prevent future builders from accidentally regressing to superseded ECHO tools, environments, architectures or methods by requiring explicit historical comparison before reuse.

supersessions.reason: ECHO requires independent scale, cloud, operating model and replaceability; legacy systems remain evidence/skill sources only.
AWS NonProd proved authenticated transactional shared persistence and readback; browser-local state is unsuitable as primary multi-counter truth.
Repeated Closing Cash/page fixes created layout, keyboard, navigation and mobile/desktop regressions.
Historical TAGRO evidence showed mature native accounting/inventory/report capability; ECHO should orchestrate rather than duplicate it.
Real multi-branch historical patterns are necessary to validate ECHO against actual business complexity.
The warehouse already separates Busy, Closing Cash, Bank, Service and projects them into entities/events/evidence/relationships; flattening would discard established structure and duplicate work.
Physical count, movement history, projected stock and historical inference are different evidence/state classes.
Operational correctness includes context, authority visibility, mobile ergonomics, interruption recovery, truthful state and role/job flow.
Persistent flaws or future inadequacy must trigger broader Planar/Prismatic comparison rather than inertia.

regression_rule: If a proposed design resembles an older superseded path, the builder must identify the supersession and state what new evidence justifies revisiting it before implementation.
